title: Api Contract
text: # API & Frontend Contract

title: Api Contract
text: This document maps the FastAPI backend routes to the UI elements in the React/Vite frontend.

title: Api Contract
text: ## Backend Routers

title: Api Contract
text: 1. **`auth.py`** - **Frontend:** AuthContext, Login/Register modals (pending UI). - **Purpose:** JWT generation, refresh, user creation.

title: Api Contract
text: 2. **`vehicles.py`** - **Frontend:** `BrowsePage.jsx`, `VehicleDetailPage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Listing EVs, filtering, pagination, fetching single vehicle details.

title: Api Contract
text: 3. **`compare.py`** - **Frontend:** `ComparePage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Returns a normalized payload comparing 2-3 requested vehicle IDs.

title: Api Contract
text: 4. **`recommend.py`** - **Frontend:** `RecommendPage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Accepts parameters (budget, daily km, state) and returns scored vehicle lists.

title: Api Contract
text: 5. **`chat.py`** - **Frontend:** `ChatPage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Intents parsing, vector retrieval, domain-specific AI chatbot.

title: Api Contract
text: 6. **`subsidies.py`** - **Frontend:** Used dynamically in `VehicleDetailPage.jsx` & `ComparePage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Calculates real-time TCO and exact subsidy deductions by state.

title: Api Contract
text: 7. **`map.py`** - **Frontend:** `StationsPage.jsx` - **Purpose:** Geospatial search for charging stations.

title: Data Dictionary
text: # Data Dictionary

title: Data Dictionary
text: ## Core Entities

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `vehicles` The primary table storing the catalog of EVs. - **segment**: TWO_WHEELER, THREE_WHEELER, FOUR_WHEELER, etc. - **brand, model, category, wheel_type** - **approx_price_inr**: Base cost - **range_km**: Rated range - **battery_kwh**: Capacity - **fame2_subsidy_inr**, **state_subsidy_inr**: Pre-calculated or cached subsidy values. - **embedding**: Vector field for semantic search.

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `users` Tracks signed-up users. - **full_name, email, password_hash** - **role**: guest, user, admin - **auth_provider**: Standard email or OAuth.

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `saved_comparisons` [Upcoming] Allows users to save a custom comparison for later viewing. - **user_id**: References `users` - **vehicle_ids**: Array of references to `vehicles`.

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `charging_stations` [Upcoming] Physical locations of charging points to be plotted on Leaflet. - **name, provider** - **latitude, longitude**: Numeric fields for map rendering. - **connector_types**: E.g., CCS2, CHAdeMO. - **fast_charging_available**: Boolean.

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `subsidy_rules` [Upcoming] Dynamic lookup table for calculating subsidies per state rather than static code logic. - **state**: e.g., Telangana, Delhi - **segment**: Vehicle category - **subsidy_per_kwh**, **max_subsidy**: Numeric limits based on policy.

title: Data Dictionary
text: ### `chat_sessions` & `chat_messages` Stores historical domain conversation for the user. - **session_id**, **user_id** - **role** (user/assistant) and **content**.

title: Roadmap
text: # EV-Compare-App Roadmap

title: Roadmap
text: This document outlines the 16-step roadmap towards a production-ready EV platform.

title: Roadmap
text: ## Phase 1: Planning and Foundation (In Progress) - [x] Audit current backend routes and match each to a real frontend page. - [x] Create a feature matrix. - [x] Normalize EV data fields from the Excel file in the schema. - [x] Decide user roles: guest, registered user, admin. - [x] Decide external providers: maps (Leaflet/OSM), LLM (Ollama), DB (Postgres/pgvector). - [x] Add `.env.example` for all secrets and config.

title: Roadmap
text: ## Phase 2: Data Pipeline First (In Progress) - [ ] Convert `India_EV_All_Segments_Dataset_2026.xlsx` into a reproducible ETL pipeline. - [ ] Create Python script that validates columns, cleans units, standardizes brands, and loads into Postgres. - [ ] Add derived fields: price_onroad_est, cost_per_km, fast_charge_supported. - [ ] Store source metadata.

title: Roadmap
text: ## Phase 3: Backend Completion (Pending) - [ ] Refactor FastAPI routes. - [ ] Setup full JWT Auth. - [ ] Add pagination / searching. - [ ] Solidify `/api/compare` and `/api/recommend`.

title: Roadmap
text: ## Phases 4-16 (Pending) - Recommendation Engine - Chatbot Design - Frontend Completion - EV Comparison Experience - TCO and Subsidy Engine - Charging Stations Map - UI & UX Redesign - SEO & PWA - Performance Optimization - Testing - Security - Production Deployment - Monitoring
